stories.name: Amazon Q2 Earnings
stories.blurb: Amazon's stronger-than-expected Q2 earnings, driven by AWS growth and heavy investment, spark a stock rally and debate over whether shares remain a buy.

stories.name: AI Spending Debt Fears
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts are increasingly worried that Big Tech's massive, debt-fueled spending spree on AI infrastructure could be an unsustainable bubble with hidden financial risks.

stories.name: Anthropic IPO
stories.blurb: Anthropic is preparing for a massive IPO, meeting investors, expanding its banking and credit lineup, and structuring founder control while launching new models and chip efforts.

stories.name: Amazon logistics expansion
stories.blurb: Amazon is rapidly growing and restructuring its delivery and logistics network through new partnerships, facilities, and jobs while facing legal and financial challenges.

stories.name: Musk Delta Starlink feud
stories.blurb: Elon Musk is publicly feuding with Delta Air Lines and its CEO Ed Bastian over the airline's refusal to adopt Starlink Wi-Fi, while rivals United and American move to poach Delta customers.

stories.name: Apple Smart Home Push
stories.blurb: Apple is launching a new lineup of smart home devices and partnerships to challenge Amazon and Google in the smart home market.

stories.name: Amazon timekeeping change
stories.blurb: Amazon is changing how time works, affecting timekeeping globally.

past.name: Amazon Qualcomm AI deal
past.blurb: Amazon is partnering with Qualcomm on AI data-center chips, boosting Qualcomm's stock and validating its data-center pivot.

past.name: Meta Muse vs Amazon
past.blurb: Meta's new Muse AI shopping agent is integrating with Shopify, PayPal, and Shop Pay to challenge Amazon, which is moving to block the rival AI checkout tool from its platform, sparking market reaction

past.name: Qualcomm-Amazon AI Chip Deal
past.blurb: Qualcomm and Amazon announced a multi-generation partnership to develop custom AI data center chips, sending Qualcomm's stock sharply higher.

past.name: Amazon ecosystem expansion
past.blurb: A wave of companies are announcing new executive hires, certifications, and platform integrations aimed at serving brands and retailers selling across Amazon and other major marketplaces.

past.name: Big Tech Stock Picks
past.blurb: Investors and analysts are weighing whether to buy, sell, or hold major tech stocks like Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle amid AI-driven market shifts.

5.text: Morgan Stanley named Amazon a top pick and raised its price target to $350, citing accelerating AWS growth and margin gains ahead of Q3 earnings on Oct. 29. Other articles debate whether the stock is undervalued before that report.

6.text: AI infrastructure costs may reach $1.5 trillion annually within five years, and the AI selloff reflects financing strain rather than fundamentals. Microsoft may stay cash-flow positive while peers face pressure; Amazon is grouped with hyperscalers whose earnings investors will watch for AI capex trends.

8.text: Anthropic’s draft IPO filing disclosed an $80.7 billion net loss for the first half of 2026 and roughly $450–600 billion in cloud computing commitments, with a public filing possible Friday and a November debut. Amazon is affected as one of the cloud providers financing and hosting those commitments.

4.text: Amazon is hiring over 300,000 U.S. seasonal workers, a 20% increase from recent years, and will invest €16 billion in Germany in 2027 across data centers, AI, logistics, and Prime Video. It also agreed to fund 12 small nuclear reactors in Indiana with X-energy and abandoned a $427 million George Washington University data center plan, pledging $65 million in land donations instead.

13.text: United Airlines says Starlink is winning customers and has connected over half its flights, while Musk predicts SpaceX could hit a $1 trillion revenue run rate by late 2027. Amazon is barely mentioned; the story matters to Amazon mainly as competition for its Project Kuiper satellite internet.

14.text: Apple launched new smart home products, including a $299 HomeView device and premium security cameras, though analysts doubt consumers will pay much more than for rival options. The articles barely mention Amazon, but the premium push bears on its cheaper Echo and Ring lineup.

15.text: None of these articles report on Amazon or timekeeping; they cover a proposed Berkshire stock gift, an Ethan Allen proxy vote recommendation, and Lending Club's IPO.
